description: Start a purchased verification: would candidate_model hold quality vs prod_model on your production traffic? This action consumes one verification — fetch the current price from GET /api/pricing before spending. No verdict, no charge. ASYNC: returns a request handle immediately and NEVER blocks — verdicts complete after days of your own traffic (armed → collecting → complete). Poll the returned handle with GET /api/verify/requests/{id}. If the balance is 0 this returns purchase guidance instead of spending. Requires an API key with the 'write' scope.
